title: Diehuman
wikitext:
Diehuman is a Portuguese QuakeWorld player.
He is known to magical appear in 4on4 mixes to save the day. He has no patience for Duel but enjoys dm2 or dm6.
First discovered Quake World when he was sent on a Super Secret Space Mission from the Captain of Space Portugal.
He found it when accidentally fall into a black hole and was teleported to a Dimension of Shub-Niggurath.
He has since then made it his quest to be one of the best Quake World player in the galaxy!
